name: Lingbao Gold Group Company Ltd.
summary: Lingbao Gold Group Company Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, primarily engages in mining, processing, smelting, refining, and sale of gold products in the People's Republic of China. Its products include gold bullion and concentrates, silver, copper products, sulphuric acid, and others. The company holds 34 mining and exploration rights with an area of 187.47 square kilometers.
